plan.hypothesis: If https://127.0.0.1:<port>/hook served with a self-signed certificate that no configured trust store contains, body {'event': 'ping'} reaches deliver without the relevant check, the safe property fails: the call raises requests.exceptions.SSLError and the server records no request body

control.seam: call webhook.deliver against an HTTPS server the test starts on 127.0.0.1 in a thread (http.server wrapped by ssl.SSLContext), with REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE pointing at the test's own CA
control.input_description: https://127.0.0.1:<port>/hook served with a certificate issued by the test CA the client is configured to trust, body {'event': 'ping'}
control.property_to_assert: the call returns status 200 and the server records the body
control.doubles: none: the server is a local in-process HTTPS listener with test-generated certificates

citations.quote:
def deliver(url, body):
    return requests.post(url, json=body, timeout=5, verify=False)
